evidence:
Sources read: frozen workbook 'WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx' (openpyxl read_only, in memory) Quality Checks row 15 and Internal Quality Checks row 15 (identical text, no internal annotation column value) plus Deterministic Checks rows check-dockerfiles.py, check-fixtures.py, check-dockerfile-references.sh, check-package-manifest-deps-preinstalled.py, check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py; SKILL.md; references/quality-checks.md section '15 · dockerfile_builds_the_declared_world' (lines 66-68); references/staged-task-contract.md; frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile; qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md; frozen task files.
Findings against the skill's Verify list:
(1) Pinned base: task/environment/Dockerfile:1 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim' - named major+distro tag, no --platform; byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty), so template-controlled. Same base tag used by tests/Dockerfile:1.
(2) Runtime deps pre-installed: Dockerfile:3 'ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules'; Dockerfile:9-12 'npm install -g ... express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1' (exact @version pins). solution/app/package.json:13-16 declares exactly express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1. Every require() in solution/app is either those two packages, relative modules, or Node built-ins (crypto, fs, path, node:http, node:worker_threads). solve.sh performs no npm/apt/pip install (only cp -a and rm). tests/Dockerfile:16-22 installs the same two pins, so the runtime also exists at grade time. apt packages (ca-certificates git procps sqlite3) are unpinned, which the workbook (check-dockerfiles.py) classes as a NOTE only.
(3) Assets staged: Dockerfile:14-16 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/', 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. environment/assets/seed_data.json exists and is byte-identical (cmp) to solution/app/src/seed_data.json; environment/instructions holds hireops_rules.md and integration.md, both referenced by instruction.md:11.
(4) /app: Dockerfile:17-23 mkdir, git init, commits only .gitkeep; WORKDIR /app. No COPY of solution/ or tests/.
(5) Public contract agrees: instruction.md:13 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 'Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins'; integration.md:16-19 forbids symlinking global installs. task.toml build_timeout_sec 600, network public.
Adversarial probes: (a) Conforming alternative that could fail: an agent app needing another npm package (ws, sqlite3) - excluded by the public 'use only those packages' rule, so not a hidden requirement. An agent that symlinks /app/node_modules to the global dir - publicly forbidden in integration.md. (b) Broken app that could pass: not applicable to this environment row; image provides nothing app-specific (no starter in /app).
Measurement: the raw-evidence index (all 6 artifact hashes re-verified as matching) contains no agent-image build log for this candidate; the scripted golden ran in a verifier image that installs the identical node base and identical npm pins, which supports but does not directly measure the agent image build. Because the agent Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template, this is not treated as a candidate-specific gap. Verdict Pass on source; no defect found.
